headline: Document automation that survives the review stage
subhead: A full n8n workflow that handles intake, enrichment, human approval, and conditional document generation so outputs don't need manual fixes every time.
subhead_secondary: Every node, every connection, every decision point is visible.
inside: Structured intake that captures what you actually need
Enrichment nodes that pull missing data before anyone reviews
Human-in-the-loop approval step with proper routing
Conditional paths based on review outcome and data state
Final document generation that reflects real decisions, not assumptions
proof: Built from real agency work. I build automation systems for $1-10M service firms. This is the exact setup I run, not a theory deck.
